item.title: It’s actually legal… we must end this loophole!!
item.description: A sitting President, like TRUMP, can own and trade stock in companies while his administration makes decisions that can move those companies’ value. How is that legal? Because 18 U.S.C. §208, the federal conflict-of-interest law that generally prevents federal officials from participating in matters affecting their own financial interests, ?specifically does not apply to the President or Vice President.? The STOCK Act prohibits insider trading, but the law still leaves an enormous presidential conflict-of-interest loophole. That needs to end! As your United States Senator, I will introduce legislation to: • Subject the President and Vice President to strict federal conflict-of-interest laws. • Ban presidents and vice presidents from trading individual stocks while in office. • Require divestment or a genuine blind trust. • Strengthen disclosure and enforcement of trading on nonpublic government information. • Require scrutiny of presidential financial transactions involving companies affected by federal contracts, regulations, tariffs, executive actions or other government decisions. And I will fight to end the use of executive privilege as a shield for corruption or criminal misconduct! No President should be able to personally profit from the power Americans entrusted to them, and then hide evidence from Congress or the public behind “executive privilege.” If fully eliminating that protection requires a constitutional amendment, I will support one. No President is above the law! No political party gets an exception! Public service should never be a personal investment strategy! It’s time to close the presidential corruption loopholes.

item.title: Look at what this homeless guy did to the cleanup I spent two days on!
item.description: I spent two days cleaning up this one spot just west of the Reconciliation Bridge. At the end of the second day I was really tired, so I grouped up the bags and decided I would do the back-and-forth bringing the bags to the trash can the next morning… Well, I get there the next morning and they were already gone. I thought to myself “9 AM on a Sunday? Did the city already grab it!?” Lo and behold, while I was taking the after photos, a homeless man came over and I found out he moved them all further down the path to the trashcan for me!!! He asked if I had an extra picker and I gladly gave him my extra. Moments like these fuel me to even greater heights! item.description: The update literally NOBODY was asking for. To catch everyone up to speed, I moved out from my aunt and uncles property this last Saturday. I had been terrified of their reaction, and spoiler alert... rightfully so. There had been some glaring red flags going on that I was ignoring for the longest. I had every intention of sneaking all my stuff out, telling them AFTER the fact, and ignoring the fallout from a distance. My aunt caught me in the middle of trying to pack my car. She went ballistic. Yelling and crying and saying I had been treating her like crap. Only thing I was guilty of was withdrawing because it was too emotionally taxing to be around her so much. She even brought my baby cousins to tell me goodbye. They were sobbing. I was crying too because stress. I told her that my parents were on their way to help me get the rest of my stuff. She told me that my parents were not allowed on the property and she would call the police if they came. Mind you. I was the primary resident in this property. My aunt, uncle, and baby cousins actually lived on another property nearby. Not that they could afford ANY of it but I digress. Just something I'm salty about behind the scenes. I told my parents what she said, and in a complete power move my parents called the police themselves. The officers basically stood to make sure nobody went nuts when we were getting my stuff out. From a legal standpoint, I had every right to invite my parents to help me get my stuff. My aunt was using an intimidation standpoint which unfortunately works on me way too well. Thankfully, my parents helped me get just about everything out. I accidentally left some things, but they were trivial things that didn't really matter and can easily be replaced. However, my aunt was sitting in the living room watching us as if we would steal any of her furniture I had been borrowing. If I moved a desk to unplug something of mine, she would start hollering about how the desk was hers and we weren't allowed to take it. She also was saying things like "this is what happens when you help people. You just get burned." Which... I'm grateful for the ways she did help me but she also caused more harm than good in some ways. Anyway I'm not allowed back to either property. Mind you when I say property I mean it in the redneck way where it's really a rundown shack. But that means I don't get access to my baby cousins, who were my reason to keep living for a long time. I started back classes in my nursing program today. I got to see my friends again. Lots of hugs and laughs today. My roommate is awesome too! Today I have actually felt more happy and free than anxious. I just worry about Wednesday when I go in to work as a substitute teacher... my aunt is a full time teacher's assistant at the school I sub at... I also made absolutely certain that there is no way they can track my location anymore. It felt so freeing. I'm scared for the immediate next steps, but my outlook overall has improved significantly. Thank you for reading, you beautiful internet folks. I love you, I'm proud of you, please hydrate with maybe a lil touch of electrolytes. TLDR; I moved, it was a complete shitshow where police were called and I lost access to my baby cousins whom I love. But I got a cool roommate, I'm around my friends more, and classes started back so I feel at ease like I never have before

item.title: I made a directory of artists who DO NOT use generative AI in their workflow that you can license, commission, or hire!
item.description:
Hey Imgur, just wanted to give you a heads up on this little labor of love I've been working on for a while now. It's called Hire Human Artists, it's at https://www.hirehumanartists.com and it's a directory where you can find hirable artists who DO NOT use generative AI in their workflow. That's the short of it. Here's more to the story...
I'm an author and an illustrator. In my publishing spaces, I see plenty of indie authors who WANT to hire artists, but don't know where to find them. Fiverr is always a huge risk as to whether or not you're going to get some gen AI slop or not. Now, I'm constantly surrounded by vocal anti-AI illustrators, so I started by putting them in a starter pack on Bluesky. The problem is, not everyone knows how to use Bluesky. So when I started linking those, people were like, "what do I do with this?" I decided to trial something. I started putting my friend's names and information into a spreadsheet. I started sharing that around. Then people were asking how to get on the sheet, and then I was asking people to help me go through all of the submissions, and then...
We had about 500 artists on the spreadsheet, fully vetted by our voting team of knowledgable artists (there's about 15 of us that look through portfolios and look at socials and make determinations based on available information), when I decided... Well, this is a LOT of people and it sure would make things easier if we had more filtering abilities, more project types, and visuals. So I built it into a full on directory with those things. Now there's so much you can filter for. You can find artists in your country, or other countries. You can find artists that'll do just about anything. You can find artists whose works are licensable. And best of all: I can link it to anyone who is asking "I need art, but I don't want AI generated anything, where do I find these people?" Since Imgur is a big art/creativity supporting site, I thought you folks might find it useful too. We're adding new artists daily, and currently have a back log of about 100 applications to go through before we re-open again (which I'm announcing through the newsletter, if you're interested, sub to that). Can't wait to see where this adventure takes us. I hope to keep the directory going for years to come!

item.title: I have beaten my yearly record for cleaning up trash and I did it all while homeless and in only 5 months!
item.description: (Part 2) With this cleanup done, despite homelessness, despite every adversity I’ve had to deal with, I have broken my yearly record for cleaning up litter! And I did it in just 5 months!(Started my first project in late March) Don’t ever let people tell you that homeless people are useless or that they don’t do anything good for our society. Point them my way and I’ll prove them wrong! If they call me an outlier…well then maybe society hasn’t found the right way to make it work for everyone’s individual needs… Or maybe it’s an issue they don’t intend to solve. I don’t think I can solve it either, but I intend to at least change a perspective or two! Total: 323 Pounds! Total for the year so far: 11,738 Pounds! Lifetime Total: 34,541 Pounds!
